AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. Supersedes AaveV3_Gnosis, disabled below.

StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every StakeWise V3 vault on Gnosis. Emits a Staking leg (vault shares) and a Borrow leg (osGNO debt) per vault, both denominated in the underlying staking asset GNO. The active vault set is configured in nav-config/meta-balance-adapters/100.json (this deploy-config holds only the constructor args) and governed on NAVCalculator via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances. underlyingToken = GNO (Gnosis stakes GNO, mints osGNO). osTokenVaultController is the same Gnosis controller osGNO_CustomPriceFeed uses. Identity derived on-chain: positionId = vault address; name = vault name().
